dealSummary: China-based AI lab Moonshot AI is in talks to raise a final pre-IPO funding round at a valuation of as much as $50 billion, Bloomberg reported.
Colossal Biosciences, a startup aiming to bring species back from extinction, is in talks to raise a round at a valuation of between $20 billion and $30 billion, Axios reported.
Digital payments company Ant International secured a $1.2 billion Series A from investors including Ant Group and Alibaba Group.
Beijing-based AI startup GigaAI is raising a new round at a $3 billion valuation and is in talks to pursue a Hong Kong IPO.
AI infrastructure startup Fluidstack raised an $830 million Series A led by Situational Awareness.
Fintech Augustus, the developer of a banking platform, secured a $180 million Series B led by Tiger Global at a $1 billion valuation.
Cyber warfare platform developer Twenty secured a $30 million investment from Khosla Ventures at a $1.2 billion valuation.
Natural, the developer of a payments infrastructure platform for AI agents, raised a $30 million Series A led by Forerunner.
AI compute platform developer SkyPilot received a $20 million seed round led by Lux Capital.

company: Cardiovascular-focused digital health startup Karoo Health
dealSummary: Cardiovascular-focused digital health startup Karoo Health raised a $16.2 million Series A led by 7wire Ventures and Allumia Ventures.
Asio Technologies, an Israel-based defense tech company, raised $15 million in a round led by Protego Ventures and Aliya Capital Partners.
Italy’s Circular Materials secured €11.8 million in SAFE financing from investors including CDP Venture Capital, the European Innovation Council Fund and EIT RawMaterials.
leadInvestors: CDP Venture Capital, the European Innovation Council Fund, EIT RawMaterials

dealSummary: Brenus Pharma, a France-based immuno-oncology startup, received €11 million in a Series A extension, bringing its total Series A to €38 million, with backers including Angelor, UI Investissement and Korea Omega Investment.
DeltaVision, a Munich-based spacecraft fluidic systems maker, raised €10.2 million in a round led by KT Ventures and Valemount Capital.
Deutsche Sanierungsberatung, a Berlin-based home renovation startup, secured a Series A of over €10 million led by Simon Capital and VERBUND X Ventures.
